Based on my search, **Procol Harum** was the first to sing "A Whiter Shade of Pale." The song was released as their debut single on **May 12, 1967**, with **Gary Brooker** as the lead vocalist. It became a worldwide hit, reaching number one in the UK and across Europe and the US.

The song was written by Gary Brooker (music) and Keith Reid (lyrics), with Matthew Fisher's distinctive Hammond organ playing becoming one of its most recognizable features. Brooker's soulful vocals over the Bach-inspired organ melody created the signature sound that made the song an anthem for the "Summer of Love" in 1967.

The first cover version by a well-known artist came shortly after, when **the Everly Brothers** recorded it for their August 1967 album *The Everly Brothers Sing*.
